description.raw: '''Active:''' '''LeBlanc''' projects an orb at the target enemy that deals magic damage and marks them for 3.5 seconds.
description.text: Active: LeBlanc projects an orb at the target enemy that deals magic damage and marks them for 3.5 seconds.

description2.raw: '''LeBlanc's''' next damaging [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|ability]] against the marked target will consume the mark to deal the [[File:Successfully enhanced damage magic icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] same magic damage again.
description2.text: LeBlanc's next damaging ability against the marked target will consume the mark to deal the same magic damage again.

description3.raw: ''Sigil of Malice's'' orb deals 10 – 146 (based on level) '''bonus''' magic damage against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] and refunds 100% of its [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost and 30% of its remaining [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown if either the orb or its mark's consumption kills the target.
description3.text: Sigil of Malice's orb deals 10 – 146 (based on level) bonus magic damage against minions and refunds 100% of its  mana cost and 30% of its remaining  cooldown if either the orb or its mark's consumption kills the target.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
65 / 90 / 115 / 140 / 165 (+ 40% AP)

leveling2.raw:
'''Total Magic Damage:'''
130 / 180 / 230 / 280 / 330 (+ 80% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Sigil of Malice'' and [[File:LeBlanc Mimic- Sigil of Malice.png|20xpx|border|link=LeBlanc#Mimic: Sigil of Malice|An icon for LeBlanc's ability Mimic: Sigil of Malice]] [[LeBlanc#Mimic: Sigil of Malice|Mimic: Sigil of Malice]] can detonate each other's marks. * The floating damage text upon the mark's detonation currently displays a real [[File:Critical strike magic icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon for magic damage critical strikes]] critical strike icon instead of a success indicator.(bug) * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Sigil of Malice and Mimic: Sigil of Malice can detonate each other's marks.
The floating damage text upon the mark's detonation currently displays a real critical strike icon instead of a success indicator.(bug)
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
